cases.name: Melinda Carley
cases.narrative:
Police found her body in her bathtub under five feet of clothing and plastic. He had put some kind of liquid in the bathtub and other powders and kitty litter and all kinds of stuff to absorb odors, and kept layering and layering, forming a seal around her
body so it wouldn't smell.
